Subject: Mountaindb Private deployment — urgent throughput degradation

Hi Ben,

We started seeing a sustained throughput drop and elevated 5xx error rates on our private Redwood deployment in our US on-prem cluster this morning (deployed in VPC peering mode). Symptoms:
- Total RPS down ~35% vs baseline since 07:30 PST.
- P95 latency up from ~120ms to ~920ms for the primary embedding route.
- Burst of 502/504 responses across several worker nodes; error rate ~4.2%.

We attached logs and a profile dump (redwood_runtime_log_20260212.gz, profile_dump_12022026.pb). Our infra team tried rolling the pod and increasing concurrency but the issue persisted. We suspect kernel mismatch or bad batching behavior after the last private runtime upgrade (v1.8.2 -> v1.9.0).

This is causing downstream app errors for our paying customers. Can Redwood prioritize an investigation and suggest immediate mitigations we can apply (model fallback, runtime flags, kernel pins)? We are available for a call now — proposed war room if you can.

Thanks,

Quick technical triage notes after an initial pass on profile_dump_12022026.pb and the runtime logs: 

Observed:
- Multiple worker processes show repeated kernel fallbacks at sequence length ~1024 leading to repeated kernel re-compiles (~30–45s stalls).
- KV cache churn is high during bursts; cache eviction coincides with increased batch formation latency.
- Batching config shows max_batch_size=64 and batch_timeout_ms=8 — seems optimized for throughput but not for tail latency under degraded cache hit rates.

Immediate actions I recommend (order matters):
1) Kernel pin: force the runtime to use the "stable-attn-v2" fused kernel for the embedding and gen routes (see attached suggested_kernels_20260214.txt). This avoids on-the-fly recompiles.
2) Lower max_batch_size to 24 and raise batch_timeout_ms to 28ms for embedding route to reduce head-of-line blocking.
3) Enable aggressive KV prefetch in the serving config (kv_prefetch=true) for hot prefixes.
4) Enable a temporary model fallback policy: redirect 20% of traffic to the q4_0 quantized variant; monitor cosine-sim drop vs threshold.
5) If kernel stalls persist, roll process to v1.8.2 runtime build in a canary pool and compare p95.

Commands/examples: 
- To pin kernel: /usr/local/bin/redwood-runtime --pin-kernel=stable-attn-v2 --route=embeddings
- To change batching at runtime via admin API: POST /admin/routes/embeddings/config { 
    "max_batch_size":24, "batch_timeout_ms":28 }

I've attached suggested_kernels_20260214.txt with checksums and a short rationale. If we can get a war room now I can push a canary patch and monitor metrics.

- Rishi
